data.one_liner: Generated client for the Serverpod service protocol.
data.what_it_does: Provides the generated client code required to communicate with a Serverpod backend service. It acts as part of the core Serverpod ecosystem for client-server communication.
use_when: You are building a Flutter or Dart app that connects to a Serverpod backend.
You need to interact with the Serverpod service protocol.
avoid_when: You are not using Serverpod for your backend.
You need a generic HTTP or REST client without Serverpod conventions.
strengths: Seamlessly integrates with the Serverpod ecosystem.
Generated client code ensures type safety with your backend.
weaknesses: Tightly coupled to the Serverpod backend architecture.
Not useful as a standalone general-purpose networking client.
data.setup_notes: Part of the Serverpod code generation tooling and dependency tree.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer a generic, lightweight HTTP client instead of a full Serverpod client setup.

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a robust, feature-rich HTTP client for REST APIs with interceptors.
